annotations.title: A company's group: GLEIF parents and subsidiaries

description:
Show a company's group: its parent and child companies from GLEIF (direct and ultimate parents), company to company, every edge with its source.
Use it to map a company's group. Don't use it to look a company up: call resolve_company first for its entity_id.
Inputs: entity_id (e.g. 'fu_7K3M9Q2XH4PZ'), depth 1 or 2.
Returns: nodes (companies), edges (from, kind parent_of, to, source, evidence), ownership (signals only; beneficial owners not covered), uncertainty.
Limits: 2 units; API key required. No people, no director links. A company without an LEI shows no links. Read-only.
name: get_graph

outputSchema.description: resolve_company and explain_match (brief 007 P1.7): the service's answer as is.
outputSchema.title: GraphOutput
